wiki.title: Amos Quick
wiki.extract: Amos Lewis Quick III (born August 14, 1968) is an American politician. He was elected to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2016. A Democrat, he has represented the 58th district (including constituents in Guilford County) since 2017.
